title: Spyglass: Officially Launched
summary: We are excited to announce the official launch of Spyglass, bringing a refined and powerful tool directly to all users.

title: Your Files, Your Way: Advanced Editor Controls
summary: Our new file management system provides unparalleled control over your embedded content, from uploading new assets to customizing how they appear within the editor.

title: Introducing Our Public Product Roadmap
summary: We're excited to announce the launch of our new public roadmap page, providing transparency into our latest achievements, upcoming features, and future plans.

title: Enhanced Checkboxes
summary: Enjoy our newly polished checkboxes that are now larger, easier to click, and fully draggable, making your workflow more efficient and delightful.

title: Seamless Team Collaboration
summary: We've made it easier than ever to collaborate, giving you more awareness and seamless ease when working with your team.

title: Enhanced Shared Item Discovery
summary: We've made it easier to discover and collaborate on shared items with your connections, ensuring you always find what you need.

title: Unlock Noeko in Your Language
summary: Experience Noeko in your preferred language as we roll out comprehensive support for global linguistic diversity.

title: Noeko: Now Open Source!
summary: We are thrilled to announce that Noeko's codebase is now open source, empowering our community with ultimate control, direct involvement, and full transparency in the project's exciting future.

title: Powerful Constellation Insights
summary: Transform your Constellation view into an active exploration hub by filtering through tags, timeframes, and shared content for unparalleled insights.

title: Advanced Search & Personalized Collections
summary: Unlock the full potential of your knowledge with enhanced search capabilities that let you filter, sort, and save your perfect views for future reference.

title: Enhanced Content Layouts
summary: Effortlessly organize your ideas and enhance your workflow with new, flexible display options for linked content, making your notes more intuitive and interactive.

title: Empower Your Workflow: Noeko Self-Hosting & Flexible Paid Plans
summary: We're launching new self-hosting capabilities and flexible paid plans for Noeko, giving you more control over your data and access to advanced features.

title: Elevated Themes & New Styles
summary: We're enhancing your experience with beautifully refined themes and an expanded collection of stylish new designs to personalize your workspace.

title: Accurate Time-of-Day Greetings
summary: We're ensuring your homepage always greets you with the perfect message, accurately reflecting your local time of day for a truly personalized experience.

title: Quickly Refine Your Tagged Content
summary: You can now easily remove items from your tags directly from the tag view, making content organization faster and more convenient.

title: Unlock a World of New Content Sources
summary: Seamlessly integrate and interact with a vast array of information, from YouTube videos and websites to text files, empowering you to gather all your insights in one central place.
